correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact product-spin transition probability and the published Poisson renewal law, a change of variables gives the periodic weighted binomial integral. A Stirling/geometric-tail calculation yields the correct sharp subcritical binomial relative-entropy exponent and N^(-1/2) tail prefactor, while a Gaussian phase saddle supplies another N^(-1/2). At critical a=1/2, local success-probability deficit is quadratic in phase and the binomial CLT threshold is O(N^(-1/2)), forcing an N^(-1/4) phase width; Chernoff bounds ensure integrability and Fubini gives the Gamma coefficient. Above threshold, binomial LLN and bounded convergence yield the exact interval integral. For fixed window coordinate xi, a triangular-array CLT and a uniform quartic tail bound yield F(xi). The original standalone verify.py ran successfully with 23 independent finite-N checks and exact Gamma integral comparison; numerical results do not substitute for the analytical limit proof. Explicit odd N, fixed or scaled parameters, and event-index scope avoid unjustified statements about physical-time Markov kinetics.

originality.rationale: The precise new claim is the evaluated, all-regime odd-N event-switch asymptotic theorem, including a singular N^(-1/4) critical phase-width, explicit Gamma coefficient, N^(-1/2) parameter window and entropy-correct subcritical prefactor. The motivating 2022 full text and entire relevant supplement already specify the microscopic model, transition location, exact finite-N binomial kernel S4 and renewal averaging S3, and discuss exponential finite-size slowdown; none of those is asserted original. Source S10 employs a fixed-parameter normal approximation that is not uniform at critical tangency and does not yield the sharp entropy rate away from criticality. The new limiting statement requires rigorous binomial large deviations, a non-Gaussian quartic saddle and triangular-array dominated convergence, absent from inspected source. Public mathematical-result semantic searches found only related, nonequivalent claims. A residual independent-publication priority risk remains.

value.rationale: The transition identified in the motivating physical work becomes operationally observable only through finite-population reset-label switching. Its previously qualitative exponentially slow finite-size behavior is sharpened to an entropy-correct exponent with a prefactor, while precisely at the physical driving threshold the switching scale changes to a non-Gaussian N^(-1/4) law with an explicit Gamma constant and a full one-parameter crossover. These distinguish exponentially long event-indexed trapping, quartic critical slowing, and positive-rate flipping in the smallest meaningful two-reset-state spin protocol. The exact asymptotic rates/critical-window function are structurally motivated physical quantities and not an arbitrary finite enumeration or a mere normalization check.
